display_name: Osa-AK battery: march, short halt, combat formation and halts
status: Numbers for simcore/battery.hpp (roadmap 7.5). The tactics are from an unnamed manual retold in video_osa (tier 4, unverified, consistent with Soviet practice; docs/research/OSA_RESEARCH_2026-10.md §7). Where a range is given, the middle is used; speeds are estimates.
notes: Composition (flak11): battery commander's PU-12M, two platoons of two 9A33 and one TZM, a maintenance vehicle.

march_spacing_m.source: video_osa (25-50 m between vehicles on the march)

threat_spacing_m.source: video_osa (200-800 m when an air attack is expected)

march_speed_mps.source: estimate (a column on a road at about 30 km/h)

short_halt_offset_m.source: estimate (off the road far enough to deploy, alternating sides); video_osa (ready to pull off the road for a short-halt engagement at any time)

deploy_s.source: mon_2112_80 p11-12 (readiness within 4 min); video_osa (a powered battery deploys in 35-50 s, unverified): the documented 4 min is used for an NPC vehicle

pair_separation_m.source: video_osa (vehicles in pairs about 3 km apart in the combat formation)

behind_covered_m.source: video_osa (1.5-3 km behind the covered unit)

reload_behind_m.source: video_osa (reload vehicles about 500 m from the pairs)

command_post_behind_m.source: estimate (the battery command post behind the pairs; video_osa places the PU-12 at the head or tail of a march column)

halt_interval_s.source: video_osa (halts every 3-4 h: equipment check, fuel, food)

halt_duration_s.source: video_osa (rest up to 2 h); 1.5 h used

night_halt_s.source: video_osa (at night shorter halts of about 1 h without breaking formation)

threat_range_m.source: samsim_osa p21 (the crew waits until a target approaches the 50 km circle): a designated target inside this makes the battery open the column (sam3d)
